A catalogue of mistakes the Codex has seen often enough to name. Each entry: the antipattern, why it is tempting, what breaks, the fix.

## Coverage

The chapter will collect the load-bearing antipatterns into themed sections. The categories below match the corpus's internal taxonomy; the entries here are de-mythologised — *antipatterns*, not *demons*, with clinical headings.

### Event sourcing — aggregates, events, envelopes

- Reading from read models during event flow (the cardinal sin: breaks replay determinism)
- Flattening event envelopes into business data
- Using evoq without reckon-db ("in-memory event sourcing" — there is no such thing in production)
- Running aggregates without the aggregate behaviour
- Manual event emission outside the aggregate

### Naming — names that do not scream

- CRUD verbs in event-sourced commands
- Technical suffixes (`_handler`, `_manager`, `_processor`)
- Parameterised phase lifecycles ("start_phase" instead of the verb-specific lifecycle)
- Generic file names in slice folders

### Structure — code organisation

- Horizontal layer folders (`services/`, `repositories/`, `utils/`)
- Process Managers nested inside Desks (PMs are sibling slices)
- Centralised listener supervisors
- Generic god modules

### Projections — read models

- Separate projections racing on a shared ETS table
- Raw records in projections (always go through evoq envelopes)
- Building projections without checkpoints
- Status fields as strings instead of bit flags

### Integration — subscriptions, messaging, process managers

- Bridging every domain event to the mesh (domain events stay local; integration facts cross)
- Side effects on hope, not on fact (acknowledging before confirming)
- Silent subscription pipeline failures
- Bypassing evoq behaviours with raw gen_servers
- Direct dispatch across Divisions (use a PM)

### Erlang / OTP — runtime gotchas

- `gen_server` self-call deadlock
- Eager defaults in `maps:get/3`
- Containerised reckon-db with dynamic BEAM node names
- Not draining queued ticks in idempotent fan-in workers

### Release, testing, packaging

- Forgetting to bump `.app.src` versions before tagging
- Hex packages without `debug_info` (dialyzer can't see them)
- EDoc-incompatible markdown backticks in `@doc` blocks
- Generated `doc/` checked into the repo

## Reading order

Consult this chapter when something goes wrong. Read straight-through is allowed but exhausting.

Each entry follows a fixed template: *Antipattern → Why it is tempting → What breaks → The fix → See also*.
